values.note: Call or stop by the park office. Payment within 7 days or the site is released; a card carries a fee. 2 nights minimum on select holiday and event weekends. After 14 nights, out for 7 days. Check-in and check-out 2 pm, 5 pm Sundays and holidays; no arrivals after 10 pm.
Johnson County Park 2026: electric and water $30 a night April-October, full hookup $45, electric only $25 November-March; plus tax. Read 2026-10-31.

note: Johnson County Parks & Recreation, near Nineveh. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25-45, 30/50A, phone. Season year_round false->true (off-season camping without water). Added 71 sites, showers, 14-night limit, 2-night event minimum. Note cleaned.
